messages:
Maya G.: Heads-up — PixelWave Labs (acct PW-319) still outstanding on INV-2026-0098. 45 days past due. Invoice total $47,890, we applied a $5,000 partial payment on 2026-03-05 so current ledger balance shows $42,890. No response to dunning #3 email sent yesterday.

Leo T.: Ugh. Do we have any active support tickets with them? sometimes product tickets get CC'd to billing.

Jin Park: No open support tickets. Reconciled charges: base subscription $35,000 + overage usage $12,890 = $47,890. Partial payment posted correctly, bank trace available if needed.

Rajiv (AcctMgr): I pinged their CFO, Anya, this morning — she said cash is tight but they want to avoid legal. Requested a payment plan: 3 installments over 60 days. Asked if we can waive late fees.

Maya G.: We generally require at least 30% upfront and we don't waive late fees without exec approval. Can finance approve a 40/30/30 split with no waiver if Rajiv can get a signed payment plan? That would be $17,156 upfront, then $12,867, $12,867.

Leo T.: 40/30/30 seems reasonable. If they sign and pay the first installment within 7 days we can pause suspension. Need written exec sign-off for fee waiver — but we're not waiving.

Jin Park: Note: if we accept the plan, change invoice status to 'Payment plan - active' and schedule automated reminders. Also set hosted-service suspension to manual review (don't auto-suspend) until the first payment clears.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Sent final notice email #3 to accounting@pixelwave.ai (2026-04-10T09:12:07Z). Delivery: delivered. Read: no.

Rajiv (AcctMgr): I'll send the draft payment agreement by EOD. If they sign, can someone confirm ledger entry and update billing flags?

Maya G.: I'll approve 40/30/30 contingent on the signed agreement and first payment within 7 days. If we don't get signature+payment within 7 days, escalate to legal and schedule service suspension 48 hours after escalation.

Leo T.: Please cc legal@redwood on the agreement so we can speed up escalation if needed.

Rajiv (AcctMgr): Will do. Draft snippet I'm sending to them now:

```
Payment Plan Proposal — INV-2026-0098
Amount due: $42,890 (balance after partial payment)
Schedule: 40% ($17,156) due within 7 days of signing; 30% ($12,867) due 30 days after signing; remaining 30% ($12,867) due 60 days after signing.
Late fee: standard late fees apply; no waivers.
Service: Active while first payment pending; suspension if first payment not received within 7 days.
Signed agreement required.
```

Maya G.: OK. Once Rajiv confirms they sign, Jin please update the invoice record and toggle the 'manual hold' flag.

Jin Park: Will do. Adding a note in the ledger: "Payment plan pending signature. 40/30/30 approved by Maya G. First payment due within 7 days."

CollectionsBot: [auto] Next action reminder scheduled for 2026-04-17T09:00:00Z.

Rajiv (AcctMgr): Follow-up: they replied, CFO Anya asked if we can move first payment to 10 days instead of 7. She says wiring bank holidays are causing delays. Asking for 10-day cushion.

Maya G.: 10 days ok as long as we require proof of wire initiation within 7 days (screenshot or payment reference) and funds clear within 10. Document that requirement in the agreement.

Leo T.: Agree. Also request a P.O. number and update the SOW reference (SOW-17) on the agreement.

Rajiv (AcctMgr): Noted — I'll add wire-proof clause and P.O. info. Sending final to Anya now.

Maya G.: Thanks. Marking thread for check-in: 2026-04-20. If payment plan not executed by then, escalate to legal and prep suspension.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Thread tag updated: "payment-plan-proposed".
